description: Searches Google Shopping (US) for a product and returns the cheapest US offers: store, price, link, rating and the savings versus the user's current price. Use when someone asks 'find this cheaper', 'best price for…', 'is there a better deal' or 'where can I buy this in the US'. Pass a product name (brand + model is best) or a product URL, plus the current price if known. Prices are indicative only – they can change, exclude tax/shipping and may differ at checkout – so never promise them. Links go straight to the retailer's product page where found (direct_link=true), otherwise to a Google Shopping link; they are never affiliate links. GS can buy the cheapest legitimate option for the customer and ship it anywhere in the US or worldwide: submit it with request_us_purchase (US delivery) or request_assisted_purchase (international), and GS confirms the total by email first. Fees: 0% when paying by crypto or bank transfer, otherwise 5% with a $5 minimum; crypto checkout is available via create_crypto_payment once GS quotes a total. Limited to a few searches per hour per client.

current_price_usd.description: What the customer would pay now, to compute savings.

product.description: Product name (brand + model) or a product page URL.

name: find_lower_price
title: Find it cheaper at US stores (compare US prices, save money)
